generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of using AI that will serve you in every module from here on. Each time you decide whether a tool fits a task, each prompt you refine, each answer you check before trusting it, is this skill at work. The habit to keep is simple: bring a tool in on purpose, direct it clearly, and check what it gives you before you rely on it.

That same habit carries into research and professional life. Wherever AI is part of the work, the people others come to trust are those who use these tools well and know when to keep them out. The critical habits you have practised here travel well beyond your degree.
